test_title: SSC MTS Official Paper (Held On: 19 May, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate meaning of the bracketed idiom in the given sentence.**

Those were remarks made **(in the heat of the moment)**.

options.text: At time when you cannot think carefully
To be dismissed from your job

solution: The correct answer is **"At time when you cannot think carefully."**
